slices.title: Bump the three @oh-my-pi dev dependencies to the release that dist-tags.latest names and regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml
slices.done_when: `pnpm install && pnpm ls --depth 0 @oh-my-pi/pi-ai @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent @oh-my-pi/pi-tui` prints one identical version for all three, equal to `npm view @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent dist-tags.latest` at that moment, `pnpm check` still exits 0, and the committed pnpm-lock.yaml resolves that same version.

slices.title: Source the effort level list and AssistantThinkingRenderContext from the host package roots and delete the local copies
slices.done_when: `cd /tmp/c4-probe && SRC=<PR 检出> bun run c4-effort.ts` and the same command with `MOCK=1` both exit 0, `grep -rn "minimal: true\|pi-tui/chat/extension-types" extensions` prints nothing, and `pnpm check` exits 0.

slices.title: Prove the changed plugin loads and enforces the host list in a real omp session inside the omp-config OrbStack sandbox
slices.done_when: With the branch checkout linked at /work/omp-thinking-translator in the OrbStack sandbox session, `/thinking-translator status` prints a line containing `effort: max` and no `configuration error` line, and after the project config's effort becomes `Low` one sent message plus `/thinking-translator status` both show `translatorModels[0].effort must be one of: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` while status also shows `enabled: false`.

open_points.point: 结果 1 confines the legal set to the config boundary and 结果 3 says only that a level sends `reasoning`; neither states whether `reasoningOptions` must itself refuse a string outside the host list. Row 1's driver calls `reasoningOptions("max")` while `THINKING_EFFORTS` is mocked to [minimal, low, turbo] and requires `{"reasoning":"max"}`, so the gate requires pass-through, while the prose alone also allows a reading in which an unknown level is dropped or rejected.
open_points.input: MOCK=1 with THINKING_EFFORTS mocked to ["minimal","low","turbo"], then `__testing.reasoningOptions("max")` inside /tmp/c4-probe/c4-effort.ts.
outputs: {"reasoning":"max"} — the pass-through the row-1 driver demands; a probe implementation that keeps reasoningOptions unchanged produces exactly this and the driver exits 0
{} or a thrown error if reasoningOptions validated against the live list; the driver's reasoningOk check would then exit 1
open_points.producer: /tmp/ghc/oh-my-omp-omp-thinking-translator-19/body.md:112-116 (the probe's `reasoning` readings) executed by body.md:143; the exported entry point is extensions/thinking-translator.ts:1314 (`reasoningOptions` in `__testing`), defined at extensions/thinking-translator.ts:846-851
open_points.searched: Read reasoningOptions (extensions/thinking-translator.ts:846-851) and the __testing export block (:1298-1319). Ran the contract's driver verbatim against a probe implementation in a /tmp copy at 18.20.2: with and without MOCK=1 both exit 0 and `reasoning.max` prints {"reasoning":"max"} in both runs, i.e. the mocked-away `max` is still passed through.

open_points.point: 结果 1 fixes only the English rejection text (`must be one of: off, …`); the same line builds a Chinese variant with `、` as separator, and neither 结果 1-4, the acceptance table, nor tests/thinking-translator.test.ts states what the Chinese text must be once the list comes from THINKING_EFFORTS. Every acceptance row runs with OMOMP_LANG=en.
open_points.input: A config `{"translatorModels":[{"provider":"p","id":"m","effort":"fast"}]}` read by a process with `OMOMP_LANG=zh` (or `LANG=zh_CN.UTF-8`), observed through the config-error notify or `/thinking-translator status`.
outputs: `translatorModels[0].effort 必须是以下值之一：off、minimal、low、medium、high、xhigh、max` (today's shape, host order)
Any other Chinese wording, or English, because the contract states no Chinese text and no acceptance row or test observes it
open_points.producer: extensions/i18n.ts:21-23 (`tr` re-reads OMOMP_LANG / LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG on every call); the message is composed at extensions/thinking-translator.ts:1088-1091, whose Chinese half joins the same list with `、`
open_points.searched: grep over tests/, scripts/, extensions/i18n.ts for `必须是以下值之一` and `EFFORT` (no hits, so no test pins the Chinese text); read parseEffortSetting and the acceptance table rows 1-7, all of which set OMOMP_LANG=en or check only the English string.

gate_gaps.row: 验收标准 第 1 行 Expect 的后半句「基准提交同一命令 exit 1（`turbo` 被拒、文本是旧六级列表）」
gate_gaps.input: `cd /tmp/c4-probe && MOCK=1 SRC=<基准 80b67ac 的检出> OMOMP_LANG=en bun run c4-effort.ts` — the row's Command only ever sets SRC to the PR checkout, so the baseline half of its Expect is never fed. (Verified it does exit 1 with `must be one of: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` when run against the base revision on 18.20.2.)

gate_gaps.row: 验收标准 第 5 行 Expect 的「`pnpm-lock.yaml` 在同一 PR 里更新」
gate_gaps.input: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (or `git status --porcelain pnpm-lock.yaml`) on a clean checkout of the PR commit — the row's command only reaches the lockfile through pnpm's frozen-lockfile behaviour, which is on only when CI is set; nothing in the row asserts that the committed pnpm-lock.yaml carries the new versions. (In a CI=true shell pnpm 12.16.1 rejects the stale lock with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE, so the row's `pnpm install` step fails before `pnpm ls` ever runs.)

gate_gaps.row: 范围边界「不应残留」的 `type Effort = NonNullable<SimpleStreamOptions["reasoning"]>` 与「插件解析不到 pi-catalog」的注释
gate_gaps.input: `grep -rn 'NonNullable<SimpleStreamOptions\["reasoning"\]>\|解析不到 pi-catalog' extensions` — row 7's pattern matches only `minimal: true` and `pi-tui/chat/extension-types`, so these two residues (base revision extensions/thinking-translator.ts:14-15) survive every acceptance row, and `tsc` accepts them because the local alias still compiles.

gate_gaps.row: 责任与必要决策「受影响的方」要求 AGENTS.md 讲 `EFFORT_LEVELS`、`SimpleStreamOptions["reasoning"]`、pi-catalog 的段落随代码改写
gate_gaps.input: `grep -n 'EFFORT_LEVELS\|SimpleStreamOptions\["reasoning"\]\|pi-catalog' AGENTS.md` — no acceptance row reads AGENTS.md, so the three statements (base revision AGENTS.md:40, :42, :97) and the level enumeration at AGENTS.md:81 stay stale after every row passes.
